constraints.name: parlay_legs_selection_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((selection)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('HOME'::character varying)::text, ('AWAY'::character varying)::text, ('OVER'::character varying)::text, ('UNDER'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: parlay_system_results_parlay_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parlay_id) REFERENCES parlays(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: parlays_parlay_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((parlay_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('STANDARD'::character varying)::text, ('SYSTEM_2_3'::character varying)::text, ('SYSTEM_3_4'::character varying)::text, ('SYSTEM_2_4'::character varying)::text, ('SYSTEM_3_5'::character varying)::text, ('TEASER'::character varying)::text, ('PLEASER'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: parlays_risk_level_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((risk_level)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('LOW'::character varying)::text, ('MEDIUM'::character varying)::text, ('HIGH'::character varying)::text, ('VERY_HIGH'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: parlays_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('DRAFT'::character varying)::text, ('ACTIVE'::character varying)::text, ('WON'::character varying)::text, ('LOST'::character varying)::text, ('PUSH'::character varying)::text, ('CANCELLED'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: transactions_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('pending'::character varying)::text, ('completed'::character varying)::text, ('failed'::character varying)::text, ('cancelled'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: transactions_transaction_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((transaction_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('DEPOSIT'::character varying)::text, ('WITHDRAWAL'::character varying)::text, ('BET_PLACED'::character varying)::text, ('BET_WON'::character varying)::text, ('BET_LOST'::character varying)::text])))

constraints.name: check_age
constraints.definition: CHECK ((EXTRACT(year FROM age((CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone, (date_of_birth)::timestamp with time zone)) >= (21)::numeric))
